messages.subject: Extracting thetas_SE in customNextItem
parts:
Good day Dr. Chalmers,

I am planning to use the customNextItem function to extract the thetas_SE in such a way that if a test reached a certain theta SE, instead of quitting in mirtCAT, it would go through the next test. However, after implementing, it does go to the next test but it is not terminating successfully (outputs a loop of error). I don't know if I'm doing it correct or is this a bug on customNextItem or extract.mirtCAT. Here is a simple reprex that I used which I patterned in one of your wiki (http://philchalmers.github.io/mirtCAT/html/multidim-example2.html)

library('mirtCAT')

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# define population IRT parameters
set.seed(1234)
nitems <- 100
itemnames <- paste0("Item.", 1:nitems)
a <- matrix(c(rlnorm(nitems/2, 0.2, 0.3), numeric(nitems), rlnorm(nitems/2, 0.2, 0.3)), nitems)

d <- matrix(rnorm(nitems))
pars <- data.frame(a, d)
colnames(pars) <- c("a1", "a2", "d")
trait_cov <- matrix(c(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1), 2, 2)

# create mirt_object
mod <- generate.mirt_object(pars, itemtype = "2PL", latent_covariance = trait_cov)

# math items definitions addition for one factor and multiplication for the other
questions <- answers <- character(nitems)
options <- matrix("", nitems, 5)
spacing <- floor(d - min(d)) + 1  #easier items have more variation

for (i in 1:nitems) {
  if (i < 50) {
    # addition
    n1 <- sample(1:100, 1)
    n2 <- sample(101:200, 1)
    ans <- n1 + n2
    questions[i] <- paste0(n1, " + ", n2, " = ?")
  } else {
    # multiplication
    m1 <- sample(1:50, 1)
    m2 <- sample(1:50, 1)
    ans <- n1 + n2 + m1 * m2
    questions[i] <- paste0(m1, " * ", m2, " = ?")
  }
  answers[i] <- as.character(ans)
  ch <- ans + sample(c(-5:-1, 1:5) * spacing[i, ], 5)
  ch[sample(1:5, 1)] <- ans
  options[i, ] <- as.character(ch)
}

# load list of items and their answers
df <- data.frame(Question = questions, Option = options, Answer = answers, Type = "radio")

set.seed(1)
pat <- generate_pattern(mo = mod, Theta = c(-1, 1), df = df)
head(pat)

customNextItem <- function(design, person, test){
  block1 <- 1:50
  block2 <- 51:100
  
  thetas_SE <- extract.mirtCAT(person, 'thetas_SE')

  if(thetas_SE[1] > 0.5){ 
    block <- block1
  } else if(thetas_SE[2] > 0.5){ 
    block <- block2
  } else return(NA) 
  ret <- findNextItem(person=person, design=design, test=test, 
                      subset=block, criteria = 'Arule')
  ret
}

#works when local_pattern is given
res <- mirtCAT(df = df, mo = mod, local_pattern = pat,
               design = list(customNextItem=customNextItem,
                             min_SEM = 0))

#errors out when doing it with GUI
res <- mirtCAT(df = df, mo = mod,
               design = list(customNextItem=customNextItem))


and here is the error that I am getting:

Warning: Error in if: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
  97: renderText
  96: func
  83: origRenderFunc
  82: output$itemTime
   2: shiny::runApp
   1: mirtCAT

Hope this helps and your help is always appreciated!

Thanks, this looks to have been a bug introduced by some new changes to the server code. The fix is on the dev version. Cheers.

Phil
